integrity: The claim is supported by an all-dimensional finite-dimensional Gram proof and binomial central/local limits, with reproducible finite rational and numerical checks. Scientific comparison is evidence, not a certificate of worldwide originality. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only Fourier degree at most one on Boolean Hamming balls. Central-limit spectrum holds for a fixed finite Gaussian coordinate; there is no uniform extreme-tail result, higher-degree theorem or external uniqueness guarantee. Injectivity/rank aspects were already implied by Hogan–Lakey general Slepian rank theory, and the general graph concentration framework predates the present formulas.
title: Exact first-Walsh-band concentration spectra on Boolean Hamming balls
